fields.title: 📖 A good word is sadaqah
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ said:**

***“A good word is a sadaqah.”***

This ḥadīth shows that the believer can attain a great reward even with his **tongue**, even if he owns no wealth.

A **sincere word**, an encouragement, a kind greeting, a reconciliation or a beneficial reminder of **Allah** can count with **Allah** as sadaqah.

**Not only money is sadaqah.**

**A good word can also be sadaqah.**

Sometimes a good word lifts a broken heart again, ends a dispute or gives a person new hope. A small statement can be easy for the speaker, yet with **Allah** it weighs **heavy on the scale**.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Never underestimate a **good word**. Whoever uses his tongue for **truth, goodness and benefit** performs a sadaqah without having to spend wealth for it.

immutable.source: 📝 Ṣaḥīḥ al-Buḫārī, Hadith Nr. 2989; Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, Hadith Nr. 1009. Überliefert von Abū Hurairah رضي الله عنه.
